name: HOYA Corporation
price_source: StockAnalysis.com + Google Finance, intraday 2026-06-23 ~09:50 JST (¥27,050; data-file ¥26,975 = prior close, consistent). An early WebSearch snippet showing ¥28,970/¥9.78T appears stale/erroneous and was discarded.
sanity_notes: Implied mcap = ¥27,050 x 0.33451B = ¥9.05tn; /157 USDJPY = $57.6B, matches data-file $57.5B and StockAnalysis ¥9.02tn / Google ¥9.08tn. Shares 334.51M confirmed across StockAnalysis + search (note: 3.58M treasury shares cancelled 2026-05-15, ~1.07%, already reflected). All three DCF per-share IVs (¥24,572 / ¥33,051 / ¥45,616) and weighted ¥31,713 fall within the 30–300% magnitude band vs ¥27,050 price; no unit/currency/share error detected.
owner_fcf_base: ~¥235bn normalized owner FCF (FY25 yr-end Mar-2026). FCF not precisely disclosed by HOYA; derived from OP ¥285.2bn / net earnings ¥253.1bn with strong cash conversion, haircut for elevated growth capex (Singapore EUV ~¥42bn, Vietnam HDD ~¥50bn Phase 1). SBC immaterial (~1.5% of FCF) so Owner FCF ≈ FCF − ~¥3bn SBC.

conservador.note: Phase1 6% / Phase2 declining to 4% / terminal 2.5%. IT capex digestion slows, HDD-glass cyclicality, modest EUV ramp. Not apocalyptic — still a high-ROIC franchise.

base.note: Phase1 9% / Phase2 5.5% / terminal 3.0%. Organic ~8% sustained, EUV mask-blank + HDD substrate secular tailwind, Life Care steady. ROIC ~21%.

optimista.note: Phase1 12% / Phase2 7% / terminal 3.5%. EUV/AI-storage demand inflects, Singapore+Vietnam capacity drives margin-accretive volume.

multiple_rationale: Anchor fair_multiple to HOYA's own 5y-avg fwd P/E of 28.5x. Current 34.0x is a ~19% premium to its own history (and well above JP med-device peers ~26x). No structural DETERIORATION — ROIC 21%, net cash, secular EUV/HDD tailwinds — so the premium is cyclical/optimism, not a re-rating to defend: NO haircut to the 5y avg, but no credit for the current premium either. iv_multiple = fwd EPS ~¥795.9 (¥743.82 TTM x ~1.07) x 28.5 = ¥22,683.
structural_change: None negative. HOYA remains a best-in-class dual-engine compounder (IT: EUV/DUV mask blanks + HDD glass substrates near-monopoly; Life Care: high-value eyeglass + contact lenses). Active capex expansion (Singapore EUV, Vietnam HDD) is growth-positive, not a deterioration. New capital policy = 100% of FCF returned + ¥110bn excess-cash release over 3yrs + progressive 40% payout dividend. Mid-cycle heavy-capex phase is the only reason the multiple is not weighted even higher.
